review_description: Living in rural NSW meant that we had two phases of electricity powering our property. That presented challenges to our battery install, however, Renewture put in significant effort to give us a good solution.

Had a battery installed by Renewture. Very professional...good advice and explanations for our specific circumstances, installation completed in two weeks, very competitive prices and long workmanship guarantee. Friendly followup call from the owner topped off a great interaction. I would highly recommend them.
my writing arm is in a sling; so this will have to do.

Peter from Renewture attended our home to quote for a storage battery system.On time, polite and very professional from the start . It was never about a sale, but what we needed and expected from a storage battery.We had plenty of questions and advised accordingly of the positives and negatives, a good learning experience which enabled us to make the right choice.About 3 weeks later, the Renewture crew showed up about 8am and by 3pm the Tesla Powerwall 3 installation was complete. They assisted with the App install on my phone and a quick schooling.A very professional and nice install leaving the garage spotless.Gary and Lorraine

The sales/quoting process occurred in a very timely and professional manner with ample opportunity for clarification of all details.The installation occurred surprising quickly with the installers being punctual, very friendly and obviously very proud of their work and the product.Customer service has been satisfactory with help in respect to the grid connection and laying the path for potential VPP involvement.

Settled with a smaller operator who bettered best quote.Because of smaller operator was able to provide a more personalised install and commisioning processInstall team showed good attention to detail, were punctual, polite and cleaned up at end of day

Our experience with Renewture has been extremely satisfying.The system design and quoting process was well thought out, took current and future needs into account and involved a thorough inspection of the proposed location to ensure the practicalities of the installation were considered, so there were no surprises at the installation phase.The installation of the solar + battery system was very efficient.  The team was well prepared, very well resourced, and completed the installation of the new system and the removal of an old system well within the agreed timeline.  The team were very friendly and cooperative and left the site clean and tidy.Customer service and communication throughout the whole process was to a very high standard.

Of the three installers I contacted, the guys at Renewture were the only ones to come out and do a face to face  sales phase (not just via phone and email). They spent the time to review our current solar set up, crunch the numbers from our power bills and come up with some suitable options for an appropriately sized battery that would integrate with our existing solar system and suit our needs.On the day of installation the team arrived on time as arranged. The installation itself was done in a neat, tidy and professional manner. In the days following the installation the guys from Renewture contacted me to see how the system is operating and to find out if I had any questions.Overall, I found the guys from Renewture to be honest and reliable. I would have no hesitation in recommending or using their services again.
Good advice on the appropriate system to install for current needs and future proofing.
The sales person was very friendly, prompt but also very professional. We are very pleased with the result.

Late last year we sought a number of quotes through SolarQuotes to upgrade our ageing 15-year-old 3KWH solar system. Although our system was still working despite a few cracks in our panels, we were concerned about the number of power outages on the grid and the hotter, and more humid weather conditions that we are likely to experience as the world warms.We also wanted to save money and were a bit jerked off about declining solar feed-in tariffs. That meant we needed a bigger system linked to a battery,In the end we went with a local company Renewture. Peter from Renewture responded immediately to our enquiry and within a few days had visited our property, checked out requirements and given us a quote.We arranged for an 8kW Solar + 9.6kWh Battery System that was installed three weeks later.The installation was extremely efficient and went off with little fuss.We can’t speak too highly of the professionalism of Peter and his team.One week later Peter returned to see that all was in order and sat with us for several hours explaining how we could get the most from the system.The system works perfectly, we can monitor our usage minute to minute via an app and since the system was installed we have drawn zero energy from the grid. The battery supplies us energy at night and in the event of a grid outage. The battery is usually fully recharged by 9.30am each day. Couldn’t be happier.

Would highly recommend Renewture to anyone considering going down the path of solar.The personalised design and advice is something you won’t get from the larger companies concerned with volume and profits over quality.Peter, Ayden and the rest of the team were very patient and also happy to answer the many questions thrown at them.

Peter and team, understand my why. Educated me on the how, advised me on the what, and nailed the brief on the where. Honestly, delayed my solar journey for years, but choosing Renewture, was an expert move.
Very happy dealing with Renewture for the installation of the system.Very knowledgeable and helpful, friendly service. Would recommend them.
